thread:
Avery Chen (CEO): Quick end-of-week check-in — two priority updates and a short incident note.
Avery Chen (CEO): 1) Private GA: scope trimmed to core inference + console UX; moving GA to next Tuesday to ensure stability. 2) Policy tweak: default request trace retention moving from 90d -> 30d for hosted tiers (enterprise exceptions documented).
Maya Patel (VP Product): Noted on GA timing. We'll freeze noncritical UI polish and run a focused canary with 5 customers. I'll post the canary checklist in #product later today.
Jon Park (VP Eng): Incident recap: yesterday ~16:20–16:38 UTC we saw a routing loop caused by an edge cache invalidation race in smart-routing. Impacted ~6% of requests (errors/timeouts). We rolled the fallback at 16:42 and traffic normalized.
Jon Park (VP Eng): Root cause identified, hotfix merged (PR #4821). Longer-term fix is a small refactor + a unit test to simulate concurrent invalidations. Postmortem draft inbound Monday.
Priya Singh (Head of Ops): Policy rollout plan: staging config push tonight, limited production rollout Mon 02:00–03:00 UTC, followed by verification. Enterprise contacts will be notified; support playbook updated: https://redwood.example.com/internal/policies/trace-retention
Priya Singh (Head of Ops): Note for billing/finance: shorter retention reduces storage costs ~8% on hosted clusters — will reflect in next ops forecast.
OpsBot: deploy:canary private-ga/v0.9 started by @MayaPatel at 2026-03-20T18:15:23Z — 5 customers, 2 regions. Status: in-progress.
Maya Patel (VP Product): @Jon — can you add the guardrail to auto-fall back to the compatible model variant if routing fails? That was a customer ask last week.
Jon Park (VP Eng): Yep. Adding a fallback policy and alert (SLO breach if fallback >5% for 15m). Will ship the change with the postmortem fix.
Avery Chen (CEO): Thanks all. Action items: Eng (Jon) — finalize fix + tests; Ops (Priya) — run retention rollout and update finance; Product (Maya) — finalize canary checklist & GTM note. Call Monday 10:00 PT for alignment. :thumbsup:
Maya Patel (VP Product): Copy. I'll ping sales with the canary customer list and update the release note.
Jon Park (VP Eng): Will add the test and a short smoke script. ETA: end of day Monday.
Priya Singh (Head of Ops): I'll monitor canary and post status in #status — will escalate if any regression seen.
Avery Chen (CEO): Appreciate the quick turnaround. Short, sharp week — focus on stability and a clean GA.
